import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of 'mrt' and 'intro.pathway'
sns.histplot(data=invasion_success, x='mrt', hue='intro.pathway', multiple='stack', bins=20)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()

# Perform ANOVA to test if there is a significant difference in 'mrt' across introduction pathways
model = sm.OLS(invasion_success['mrt'], sm.add_constant(invasion_success['intro.pathway'].astype('category').cat.codes))
results = model.fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(results, typ=2)
anova_table

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of 'mrt' and 'intro.pathway'
sns.histplot(data=invasion_success, x='mrt', hue='intro.pathway', multiple='stack', bins=20)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()

# Group the data by 'intro.pathway' and extract the 'mrt' values
groups = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['mrt'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]

# Perform one-way ANOVA
f_statistic, p_value = f_oneway(*groups)
f_statistic, p_value

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

model = sm.OLS(invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots'], sm.add_constant(invasion_success[['mrt', 'intro.pathway'].astype('category').cat.codes]))
results = model.fit()
results.summary()

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Convert 'intro.pathway' to a categorical variable
invasion_success['intro.pathway'] = pd.Categorical(invasion_success['intro.pathway'])

# Perform multiple regression to assess the interaction between 'intro.pathway' and 'mrt' on 'number.of.invaded.plots'
model = ols('number.of.invaded.plots ~ mrt + C(intro.pathway) + mrt:C(intro.pathway)', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of 'mrt' and 'intro.pathway'
sns.histplot(data=invasion_success, x='mrt', hue='intro.pathway', multiple='stack', bins=20)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()

# Check the correlation between 'mrt' and 'number.of.invaded.plots'
sns.scatterplot(data=invasion_success, x='mrt', y='number.of.invaded.plots', hue='intro.pathway')
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time and Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Check the correlation between 'mrt' and 'invaded.niche.breadth'
sns.scatterplot(data=invasion_success, x='mrt', y='invaded.niche.breadth', hue='intro.pathway')
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time and Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

# Display summary statistics for 'number.of.invaded.plots' and 'invaded.niche.breadth' by 'intro.pathway'
invasion_success.groupby('intro.pathway')[['number.of.invaded.plots', 'invaded.niche.breadth']].mean()
